prose: Orchestrator, 2026-11-13, Group H item 4 (H3): three proofs red with a Windows path in the result. bin/proofs/test_cairn_instance_address.py compares what `cairn <device>.<n> <verb>` prints to str(root / ...). The dispatcher joins its own parts with slash under a root Windows spells with backslashes, so the printed line is C:\Users\...\devices/<device>/0/bin/verb while the expected string is all backslashes.
